Label: BandConfiguration
Comment: Structured description of raster band organization and semantics (e.g., band count and ordered band names). Intended to be used as the value of geocr:bandConfiguration.

Label: MultiWavelengthConfiguration
Comment: Structured description of multi-wavelength channel configuration for Space Weather / heliophysics datasets (e.g., a list of wavelength channels). Intended to be used as the value of geocr:multiWavelengthConfiguration.

Label: SolarInstrumentCharacteristics
Comment: Structured description of solar/heliophysics instrument and observatory characteristics for Space Weather datasets (e.g., observatory/platform and instrument identifiers). Intended to be used as the value of geocr:solarInstrumentCharacteristics.

Label: SpectralBand
Comment: Structured per-band spectral metadata entry (e.g., center wavelength and bandwidth). Intended to be used as items within geocr:spectralBandMetadata.
